MR Safety
The Zephyr Embolization Coil System is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5 and 3.0 Tesla
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 25 T/m
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode
RF Transmit Coil Type Any transmit coil may be used
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 4 W/kg
